subject: POC kickoff — mutual success criteria, evaluation owners & timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Thomas <jenna.thomas@novarohealth.com>, Mark Simmons <mark.simmons@novarohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC kickoff — mutual success criteria, evaluation owners & timeline

Hi Jenna / Mark —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I want to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) for the 6-week Proof of Concept so we can align on success metrics, who owns prompt/eval artifacts, and the gating timeline for a potential Q1 pilot.

High-level ask for this thread: can we confirm the core success criteria below and nominate owners on your side for prompt examples and procurement items? We'll use this to create a shared tracker.

Proposed success criteria (please react/comment):
- Accuracy on 3 clinician-facing flows: medication reconciliation, discharge summary extraction, and coding suggestion (target: >= 92% precision on benchmark labeled set)
- Inference latency: p95 <= 250ms for single-turn generation under expected load profile
- Cost envelope: projected per-1000 token cost under committed model/quantization profile <= $X (we'll provide blended numbers)
- Security/compliance: keys in your KMS (or ours), audit log retention can be set to 90 days for the pilot

Owners we suggest from Redwood:
- Technical lead / runtime tuning: Dev Patel
- Evaluation design / bench authoring: Chloe Martin
- Success manager / commercial: Laura Bennett

Can you confirm: 1) these criteria make sense from Novaro's side, 2) who will own prompt/eval artifacts on your team, and 3) any non-negotiable procurement timing (PO date) we should track against?

Attaching a starter MAP (spreadsheet) and a short benchmark template — feel free to edit.

Attachment: NH-POC-MAP-v1.xlsx (XLSX)
Attachment: benchmark-template.md (MD)

Thanks,
Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jenna Thomas <jenna.thomas@novarohealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Simmons <mark.simmons@novarohealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — mutual success criteria, evaluation owners & timeline

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear summary and attachments. Overall these success criteria look right; a couple of comments from our side:

- For precision on coding suggestions we want to measure both micro and macro F1 on the benchmark; can your benchmark template include both?
- Latency target aligns, though we want a separate SLA for batched inference (expected for our nightly pass).
- Procurement: procurement needs a signed SOW and PO by 2026-12-20 to make the December funding window; if that date slips to January it becomes a Q2 consideration for budget.

Owners from Novaro:
- Clinical evals & labeled set: Jenna Thomas (me)
- Prompt examples & in-product sample flows: Mark Simmons
- Procurement / legal contact: procurement@novarohealth.com (CC'd)

I'll review the attached MAP and add estimated availability for our subject matter experts. Two small asks: include a column for "bench labeled set source" and one for "masking / PHI handling notes" so we can sign off compliance quickly.

I'll aim to have the annotated MAP and an initial labeled set sample by end of day Monday (2026-11-17).

Thanks,
Jenna
Head of Clinical Integrations | Novaro Health
jenna.thomas@novarohealth.com
